official_rules: Patterned parts include both printing on plastic and parts moulded with multiple plastic colours.
Every patterned part should be based on a plain unpatterned library part even when LEGO never issued the part plain.
Pattern/sticker geometry may use Direct Colours; ordinary geometry colors must be in LDConfig.
Printed metallic decoration generally uses LDraw Metallic Colours rather than Chrome/Pearl, subject to exceptions.
Patterned-part keywords are encouraged to carry external inventory cross-references.

agent_os_interpretation.surface_print: decoration candidate; base geometry remains separate
agent_os_interpretation.multi_colour_mould: geometry may be same but material-region segmentation matters
agent_os_interpretation.dual_mould: retain manufacturing/material-region semantics separately from surface ink
agent_os_interpretation.texmap: texture-based representation; preserve source texture/license and fallback geometry state
agent_os_interpretation.sticker: not equivalent to direct UV print; formed sticker geometry may still teach surface wrapping
